verdict_reason: The contact address scan is removed correctly, but the review step inlines a copy of an existing journey helper and the addresses-exit steps differ from the sibling specs.

todos.issue: The new 'Review your notification' step (163-168) is a copy of animalsJourney.toDeclarationThroughReview's body (journey.ts:782-788), which this spec used to call and which now has no caller; the same copy sits in notification-journey-filled-state.spec.ts:157-162. The 'CPH number' step (117-122) repeats the leave-the-addresses-hub sequence from the other two a11y journey specs, here returning to Overview by overview.open(notificationView.referenceNumberFromUrl()) where they call animalsJourney.openCurrentOverview().
todos.fix: Must: the review-scan-then-continue step and the leave-the-addresses-hub step each live once on AnimalsJourney, and this spec calls them, so all three a11y journey specs return to Overview the same way. One way: call animalsJourney.toDeclarationThroughReview(runA11yScan) and a shared AnimalsJourney method for the CPH-to-Overview steps, deleting the inline copies.
